regions.region: Figure 1, 2b and 3b drawings plus X-ray structures
regions.finding: Structural-characterization evidence confirms the C-S bond and E geometry of 2b and identifies unconjugated 3b. It is retained in source_context and the entry-5 minor-product outcome, not treated as an independent preparative arrow.
General scope conditions were read directly: benzyl allenoate 150 mol%, RSH 1a-1l, Et3N 20 mol%, THF 0.5 M, 70 °C, 24 h; all products >20:1 E/Z. Footnote b changes 2b to 150 mol% Et3N.

Twelve independent scope products were recorded with isolated yields: 72, 92, 93, 84, 82, 68, 83, 99, 75, 92, 68 and 82%. Structures were transcribed as machine candidates with explicit E geometry and remain needs_review.
